GROUP BY TO_CHAR(col.collecttime,'YYYYMM'), TO_CHAR(col.collecttime,'YYYY-MM-DD'), pm.matcode, user1.CNAME

GROUP BY TO_CHAR(col.collecttime,'YYYYMM'), TO_CHAR(col.collecttime,'YYYY-MM-DD'), pm.matcode, user1.CNAME )aa group by aa.collect_MONTH, aa.collect_DATA, aa.CNAME order by aa.collect_MONTH desc,aa.collect_DATA, aa.CNAME )aa2 group by aa2.collect_MONTH,aa2.collect_DATA
)aa3 group by substr(aa3.collect_MONTH,0,4), aa3.collect_MONTH order by aa3.collect_MONTH desc

with indata as( select aa.statmonth, sum(aa.qty) as qty, count(*) as kindqty from( select sum(col.qty) as qty, pm.matcode, TO_CHAR(col.collecttime,'YYYYMM') AS statmonth
from intaskitem item, inbill bill, inproof out, incollectdata col, storesite site, storeroom room, pm_material pm where bill.TRANSACTION_TYPE=10 and col.inTASKITEMID=item.inTASKITEMID and item.inbillid=bill.inbillid and bill.inPROOFID=out.inPROOFID and col.insite=site.storesiteid and site.storeroomid=room.storeroomid and pm.pm_materialid=col.materialid
group by pm.matcode, TO_CHAR(col.collecttime,'YYYYMM')
)aa group by aa.statmonth order by aa.statmonth asc ), gw_month as( SELECT month_list.year_id, month_list.month_id, month_list.start_year, month_list.ly_month_id, month_list.ly_start_year, month_list.prev_month_id FROM ( SELECT ny.*, ny.year_id||'01' as start_year, substr(ny.ly_month_id,0,4)||'01' as ly_start_year FROM dim_month ny WHERE month_id >= '202101' AND month_id <= #{month_id} ) month_list WHERE 1=1 ), indata_all as( select gw_month1.year_id, gw_month1.month_id, indata1.qty, indata1.kindqty, null as ly_qty, null as ly_kindqty from gw_month gw_month1 left join indata indata1 on indata1.statmonth=gw_month1.month_id
union all
select gw_month2.year_id, gw_month2.month_id, null as qty, null as kindqty, indata2.qty as ly_qty, indata2.kindqty as ly_kindqty from gw_month gw_month2 left join indata indata2 on indata2.statmonth=gw_month2.ly_month_id ), indata_month as( select year_id, month_id, sum(nvl(qty,0)) as qty, sum(nvl(kindqty,0)) as kindqty, sum(nvl(ly_qty,0)) as ly_qty, sum(nvl(ly_kindqty,0)) as ly_kindqty from indata_all where month_id>(cast((cast(substr(#{month_id},0,4) as int)-2) as varchar2(4))||'01') and month_id <= #{month_id} group by year_id, month_id ) select year_id, month_id, round(qty/10000,2) as qty, round(kindqty,2) as kindqty, round(ly_qty/10000,2) as ly_qty, round(ly_kindqty) as ly_kindqty, case when ly_qty=0 then null else (round(((qty-ly_qty)/ly_qty)*100,2)) end as qty_voy, case when ly_kindqty=0 then null else (round(((kindqty-ly_kindqty)/ly_kindqty)*100,2) ) end kindqty_voy from indata_month order by month_id asc
